ios.desc:
Most metronome apps are either too basic or locked behind a paywall. Lick gives you advanced features, completely free.

Features:
• High-precision audio engine — less than one second of drift over 48 hours of continuous playback.
• Subdivisions — see and hear the subdivisions of every beat.
• Sound library — choose between woodblock, hi-hat, and classic metronome sounds.
• Clean, distraction-free interface — designed to stay out of your way while you practice.
• Tap tempo — make Lick follow the rhythm of your favorite songs, easily and naturally.
• Time signatures.
• Tempo markings from Grave to Prestissimo.

Every metronome feature is free. If you enjoy Lick, you can support its development by unlocking custom themes — colors, dark mode, and photo backgrounds — as an optional purchase.

android.desc:
Lick is a high-precision metronome built for musicians who care about the rhythm being just right.

Most metronome apps are either too simple or locked behind a paywall. Lick gives you professional-grade features for 
free.

Features:
• High-precision timing — engineered for accuracy, not just close enough
• Subdivisions — visualize and hear beat subdivisions (often a paid feature elsewhere)
• Sound library — choose between wood block, hi-hat, and classic metronome sounds
• Clean, distraction-free interface — designed to stay out of your way while you practice.
• Tap tempo
• Time signatures
• Tempo markings from Grave to Prestissimo
